title: 第29章 砸烂星斗宫祖龙之危第30章 祖龙残魂孤救定了
slug: 重生商纣开局怒怼圣人女娲
content_zh:
第29章砸烂星斗宫，祖龙之危！“师妹，说吧，该来的都来了，不该来的也来了，还有什么不能说的！”
仿佛察觉到王母憋的痛苦，昊天趴在地上有气无力地说着，
哪怕他身为天帝，拥有圣人级别的不灭天帝身，接连被四名圣人级别的攻击打中，也让他有种身子要散架的感觉。
听到昊天的话，王母仔细一想——
三清加上三皇都来了，女娲现在看见人族就头疼，自然不会管，西方教巴不得天下大乱，也绝对不会出手，
至于地道圣人后土，更不可能插手此事了！
想来想去，
王母也想不到其他人了，于是缓缓松开一只手，低声道：“师……”
刷刷！
就在她刚刚吐出一个字时，两道圣人光辉忽然从天而降，接引、准提二圣仿佛火烧尾巴一样，飒的一下出现在昊天身边。
王母：“……”
看着趴在地上披头散发，浑身是血的昊天，二圣眉头紧蹙。
“师兄，天帝伤得好重啊？”
“师弟，天帝拥有不灭天帝身，些许小伤无伤大雅！”
“师兄说的是，现在的当务之急，还是让洪荒重现光明，可天帝这样，还能催动星斗宫吗？”
“师弟，先带天帝去星斗宫，把遮天之力收走，其他的事情都是小事，不过天帝这样，估计有些不方便，你我二人还是送他一程吧！”
“师兄，大善！”
接引、准提丝毫不管昊天身上的伤，一个抬着左手、一个抬着右手，同时捂住昊天刚刚张开的嘴，飒的一下化成一道光向着星斗宫冲去！
王母：“不行，我要去找大老爷，照这些圣人的玩法，师兄不死也得废了！”
想到这，

王母迅速向着天外冲去！
此时，
在接引、准提的帮（wei）助（xie）下，在消耗了大量自身功德后，昊天的伤势终于恢复了一大半，可以站在星斗宫外。
此时，
昊天脸上露出了吃屎般的表情！
刚刚，他可是消耗了正常情况下三倍的功德，才让自己的伤势恢复了大半，到现在心还在滴血。
可是在接引、准提虎视眈眈的注视下，再加上三清和三皇之前的威胁，委屈巴拉的昊天，也只能出此下策了，
没办法，
一旦洪荒天亮，黑暗依旧笼罩洪荒后，他就真的要倒霉了！
可就在这时，
咔嚓！
一声巨响，星斗宫上忽然裂开一道巨大的缝隙，恐怖的人道之力从这道裂缝中涌出，直接让整个天庭发生了巨大的震动。
“这是怎么回事？”
昊天看向那道裂缝，心里忽然涌出一股强大的不安，就连不远处的接引、准提，脸色也都发生了变化。
下一刻，
轰！
一声巨响，仿佛虚空崩碎，笼罩在星斗宫周围的那片天道之力，直接被海量的人道之力冲散。
紧接着，
散发着万道金光的人皇玺，带着毁天灭地的可怕气势从天而降，轰地一声砸在星斗宫上！
咔嚓、咔嚓、咔嚓……

伴随着一道道清脆的碎裂声，巨大的星斗宫上，迅速出现一道道皲裂，眨眼间蔓延到了整个星斗宫。
短短几个呼吸的时间，在西方二圣和昊天震惊的注视中，可以控制诸天星辰运转的星斗宫，轰地一声当场爆碎！
与此同时，
滚滚人道之力翻滚，眨眼间凝聚成了帝辛的身影，
content_en:
Chapter 29 Smashing the Star Dou Palace, the Ancestral Dragon is in danger! "Junior sister, tell me, everything that should come has come, and everything that shouldn't come has come, there is nothing else you can't say!"
As if aware of the Queen Mother's suppressed pain, Haotian lay on the ground and said feebly,
Even though he was a Heavenly Emperor with a Saint-level Immortal Heavenly Emperor body, being hit by four Saint-level attacks one after another made him feel like his body was about to fall apart.
After hearing Haotian's words, the Queen Mother thought carefully——
The Three Pure Ones and the Three Emperors are here. Now that Nuwa has a headache when she sees the human race, she will naturally not care about it. The Western Sect wishes for chaos in the world and will never take action.
As for the authentic saint Hou Tu, it is even more impossible to interfere in this matter!
After much thought,
The Queen Mother couldn't think of anyone else, so she slowly let go of one hand and whispered: "Master..."
Swish!
Just when she uttered a word, two rays of saintly light suddenly descended from the sky. The two saints Jie Yin and Zhunti appeared beside Haotian with a sudden sound, as if their tails were on fire.
Queen Mother: "..."
Looking at Haotian lying on the ground with disheveled hair and blood all over his body, the Second Saint frowned.
"Senior brother, how seriously injured is the Emperor of Heaven?"
"Junior brother, the Emperor of Heaven has the body of an immortal Emperor of Heaven, so a few minor injuries are harmless!"
"Senior brother said that the top priority now is to bring light back to the ancient world. But can the Emperor of Heaven still activate the Star Dou Palace?"
"Junior brother, first take the Emperor of Heaven to the Star Dou Palace and take away the power of covering the sky. The other things are trivial matters. However, it is probably a little inconvenient for the Emperor of Heaven to be like this. You and I should give him a ride!"
"Senior brother, great kindness!"
Jieyin and Zhunti didn't care about Haotian's injuries at all. One raised his left hand and the other raised his right hand. At the same time, they covered Haotian's opened mouth, and suddenly turned into a ray of light and rushed towards the Star Dou Palace!
Queen Mother: "No, I'm going to find the eldest master. According to the way these saints play, my senior brother will be crippled even if he doesn't die!"
Thinking of this,
The Queen Mother quickly rushed towards the sky!
At this time,
With the help of Jie Yin and Zhunti, and after consuming a lot of his own merit, Haotian finally recovered more than half of his injuries and could stand outside the Star Dou Palace.
At this time,
Haotian had a shit-eating expression on his face!
Just now, he spent three times the normal amount of merit to recover most of his injuries, and his heart is still bleeding.
However, under the eager gaze of Jie Yin and Zhunti, coupled with the previous threats from Sanqing and Sanhuang, Haotian, who had wronged Bala, had no choice but to make this decision.
No way,
Once dawn breaks in the prehistoric era and darkness still covers the prehistoric era, he will really be in trouble!
But at this moment,
Click!
There was a loud noise, and a huge gap suddenly opened in the Star Dou Palace. The terrifying power of humanity surged out from the gap, causing a huge shock to the entire heaven.
"What's going on?"
Haotian looked at the crack, and suddenly a strong uneasiness surged in his heart. Even the expressions of Jieyin and Zhunti not far away changed.
The next moment,
Boom!
There was a loud noise, as if the void was shattering, and the heavenly power that enveloped the Star Dou Palace was directly dispersed by the massive human power.
Immediately afterwards,
The Human Emperor's Seal, which exuded thousands of golden lights, fell from the sky with a terrifying aura that destroyed the heaven and earth, and hit the Star Dou Palace with a bang!
Click, click, click...
Along with the crisp cracking sounds, cracks quickly appeared on the huge Star Dou Palace, spreading to the entire Star Dou Palace in the blink of an eye.
In just a few breaths, under the shocked gazes of the Second Sage of the West and Haotian, the Xing Dou Palace, which can control the movement of the stars in the sky, exploded with a bang on the spot!
At the same time,
The rolling power of humanity rolled over and condensed into Di Xin's figure in the blink of an eye.
